text: Aris wrote that R. came about the machines again. She told him no, and he said she'd regret it.

leads.text: Who's R., and which machines? Marguerite knows everyone's business: ask her.

text: Tobias heard shouting and breaking glass from the maker space just before midnight.
Kofi saw a big man in a long coat run from the maker space, holding his arm.
Raymond says he was at home going over the accounts all night.
